ideas.title: Sculpt for Gems
ideas.hook: Every boulder hides a gem. Chip it into a statue to free it: the cleaner your sculpture, the rarer the gem that drops out.
core_loop: Pick a boulder from the quarry wall
Chisel it into a shape using a template or freehand
Get scored on accuracy; a gem drops based on the score
Display statues on your plot for passive cash and buy better chisels
ideas.twist: Other players walk your plot and like statues; the most-liked statue each hour gets a free Divine gem roll.
retention: Bigger boulders unlock in new zones
ideas.why_now: Paint × stones is the top open gap (score 8.33). Stones/rocks is the second-fastest theme at 2.75× (+1 Stone Skipping 51.1K CCU at 36 days, Lift Rock For Eggs 13.5K at 14 days), break/mine is the fastest mechanic at 3.13× and paint/create is at 2.08× led by Paint to Get Rich 🎨[NOW] at 31.7K.
ideas.differentiator: Mining games reward clicks; here the reward depends on how well you shape the rock, so skill and showing off matter.

ideas.title: Dice for Eggs
ideas.hook: A giant board game loops around the map. Roll the dice, land on a tile, and hatch whatever egg sits there. Doubles let you steal the egg on someone else's tile.
core_loop: Roll dice to move around a shared board
Land on egg tiles and hatch pets
Pets add bonus pips to your rolls
Lap the board to raise egg tier
ideas.twist: Rolling doubles lets you jump onto another player's tile and swipe their unhatched egg.
ideas.why_now: Dice × eggs is the #2 open gap (score 7.22). Dice/cards is rising at 2.11× with [🎉 UPD 7] Anime Dice at 52.2K CCU after 57 days, and hatch × steal is the strongest young pair (19 young games, 287.7K CCU) led by Break and Steal an Egg at 160.1K. The "___ for ___" title formula is the fastest at 4.19×.
ideas.differentiator: Egg games make you walk and click; here a shared board and dice luck decide who gets which egg, so every roll is a small gamble everyone watches.

ideas.title: Dye for Eggs
ideas.hook: Plain eggs roll in on a conveyor. Dip, splatter and paint them in your dye shop; the colour pattern you make decides what hatches.
core_loop: Collect blank eggs from your conveyor
Paint or dip them in dye vats
Hatch them: patterns map to pet types and rarity
Sell pets or upgrade vats for rarer dyes
ideas.twist: Secret colour recipes (e.g. lava stripes + gold dots) hatch secret pets, and players trade recipes, not just pets.
retention: Recipe book that fills as you discover combos
ideas.why_now: Paint × eggs is the #3 open gap (score 7.11). Paint/create is rising at 2.08× (Paint to Get Rich 🎨[NOW] 31.7K CCU) and eggs hold 20% of young-game CCU with Steal Animal Egg at 27.1K after 30 days. Tycoon/base building is at 2.08× and hatch × tycoon has 7 young games at 61.6K CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Egg games hand you random hatches; here your own paint job steers the result, so creativity is the luck boost.

ideas.title: +1 Speaker Size
ideas.hook: Every beat you hit makes your speaker +1 bigger. Big enough and the bass blasts other players off the map.
core_loop: Tap on the beat to grow your speaker +1
Bigger speakers push nearby players back
Blast players off the stage for bonus size
Rebirth for louder speaker skins
ideas.twist: Players can team up and sync speakers; when two hit the same beat the blast doubles.
ideas.why_now: +1 × music is an open gap (score 4.76). +1 stat is rising at 2.23× and the "+1 ___" formula at 2.42× (+1 Stone Skipping 51.1K CCU, +1 Wings For Eggs 17.3K). Music/dance is at 1.45× with Piano Rhythm Tiles at 5.6K after 24 days and [UPD] Aura Dance Battles 🔥 at 5.5K.
ideas.differentiator: Rhythm games score points; here the score is a physical speaker that knocks people around, so growth is visible and funny.

ideas.title: Burrow for Cover
ideas.hook: A meteor storm hits every 10 minutes. Dig straight down under your plot, build a shelter, and hope your tunnel is deep enough.
core_loop: Dig down under your plot and collect ore
Spend ore on walls, supports and rooms
Survive the storm; deeper shelters take less damage
Repair, dig deeper, survive bigger storms
ideas.twist: Storms crack open neighbour tunnels, so you can dig sideways into their bunker and grab loot while they repair.
monetization: Shield pass for one free repair
ideas.why_now: Break × disaster is an open gap (score 5.72) and break/mine is the fastest mechanic at 3.13× ((🩸) Drill for Eggs 19.7K CCU at 25 days, Break and Steal an Egg 160.1K). Survive × tycoon is a top young pair (5 games, 52.6K CCU) with Bunker vs Verity at 22.3K after 19 days; the newcomer Smash the City is already at 5.4K.
ideas.differentiator: Bunker games build up; here you dig down, so every block mined is both loot and safety.

ideas.title: Brush vs Zombies
ideas.hook: Zombies march down the lanes. You don't place towers: you paint them. Red paint burns, blue paint freezes, yellow paint zaps.
core_loop: Paint coloured patches onto the lanes before the wave
Zombies take effects based on the colours they walk over
Earn paint from kills
Unlock new colours and bigger brushes
ideas.twist: Mixing colours makes new effects (red + blue = steam that slows and burns), so every lane becomes a puzzle.
ideas.why_now: Paint × zombies is an open gap (score 4.53). Paint/create is rising at 2.08×, zombies at 1.30× (Build and Kill Zombies 24.5K CCU after 53 days), and tower defense at 1.30× ([🏆UPD+X2💰] Cameraman Tower Defense 14.5K). The "___ vs ___" formula is at 2.49× (Ball VS Ball 53.2K, Bunker vs Verity 22.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Tower defense is about placement; here it's about painting patterns and mixing colours, which feels new and looks great in clips.

ideas.title: Roll for Drip
ideas.hook: Each round you roll dice for every piece of your outfit: hat, top, shoes. Bad rolls happen. Style what you got and win the runway vote anyway.
core_loop: Roll dice for each outfit slot
Spend one reroll on your worst piece
Walk the runway; players vote
Winners get gems to buy luckier dice
ideas.twist: You can spend your reroll on a rival's slot instead, swapping their best piece for a random one.
ideas.why_now: Dice × fashion is an open gap (score 5.6). Dice/cards is at 2.11× ([🎉 UPD 7] Anime Dice 52.2K CCU), fashion is at 1.67× and the Dress Up subgenre at 1.60× led by Makeup Mania! BETA [LASH TECH UPDATE] at 36.0K after 16 days and Dress Designer at 5.0K after 17 days.
ideas.differentiator: Dress-up games let you pick anything; here luck gives you the pieces, so the fun is making a bad roll look good.

ideas.title: Splash vs Blaze
ideas.hook: Two teams, one map. Team Blaze sprays lava paint, team Splash sprays ice paint. Whoever covers more ground when the timer ends wins.
core_loop: Pick a team and spray your element across the map
Your paint speeds you up; enemy paint slows you
Every tile painted adds +1 to your sprayer size
Win rounds to unlock new nozzles
ideas.twist: Ice paint freezes lava tiles and lava melts ice, so each team can flip the other's ground, not just cover blanks.
ideas.why_now: Paint × ice/fire is an open gap (score 6.77). Ice/fire is the third-fastest theme at 2.14× (Firefighting Sim 🚒 28.3K CCU at 19 days, Melt All The Ice!🧊 7.3K at 28 days), paint/create is at 2.08× and +1 stat at 2.23×. The "___ vs ___" formula is at 2.49× led by Ball VS Ball at 53.2K.
ideas.differentiator: Element games are solo sims; this is a fast team round where you can flip the other side's paint, so comebacks happen.

ideas.title: Weld for Wheels
ideas.hook: Scrap piles everywhere. Weld bumpers, engines and wheels into a car that barely holds together, then race it.
core_loop: Scavenge scrap parts from junkyards
Weld parts into a car at your garage
Race on tracks to earn cash and rare parts
Upgrade the welder and build faster, weirder cars
ideas.twist: Bad welds fall off mid-race and other players can pick up your dropped parts.
ideas.why_now: Forge × vehicles is an open gap (score 5.17). Forge/craft is rising at 1.68× ([BOSS]+1 Loot To Forge 44.4K CCU after 60 days), vehicles at 1.22× (Firefighting Sim 🚒 28.3K, Steal A Car 10.8K) and collect/index at 2.34×.
ideas.differentiator: Car games let you buy cars; here you build one from scrap, so every car is different and every race has surprises.

ideas.title: Build a Quarry
ideas.hook: Start with a pickaxe and a hill. Blast it, add crushers and conveyors, and grow it into a giant quarry that digs itself.
core_loop: Mine rock by hand
Buy drills, crushers and conveyors
Process rock into gravel, gems and gold
Expand the pit deeper for rarer ores
ideas.twist: At night, players can sneak into other quarries and steal uncut gems off the conveyor before they're processed.
ideas.why_now: Break/mine is the fastest mechanic at 3.13× and stones/rocks the second-fastest theme at 2.75× (+1 Stone Skipping 51.1K, Lift Rock For Eggs 13.5K). Tycoon/base building is at 2.08× and the "Build a ___" formula at 1.28× (Build the Pyramid! 19.0K after 38 days). Break × steal is a strong young pair at 160.8K CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Mining sims keep you clicking one rock; here you build a whole industrial pit that runs itself, with night raids for drama.
